tool_input.description: Read captcha enabled flag from dev API
tool_input.command: try { $captchaResponse = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri 'http://172.27.13.11:8080/code' -Method Get -UseBasicParsing -SkipHttpErrorCheck -TimeoutSec 15; $captchaData = $captchaResponse.Content | ConvertFrom-Json; 'HTTP {0}; captchaOnOff={1}; imagePresent={2}; uuidPresent={3}' -f $captchaResponse.StatusCode, $captchaData.captchaOnOff, [bool]$captchaData.img, [bool]$captchaData.uuid } catch { 'Captcha metadata request failed; error type={0}' -f $_.Exception.GetType().Name }
